notes.title: *New Steam Page*
notes.content:
Welcome to all the new peeps we met at Gameforce! Thank you for coming by and checking out our game ^^

Anyway, small update from our side: we upgraded our steam store page!
We've got some nice new gifs - with some moments that anyone who played the demo might recognize -, more accurate descriptions of our game, and a couple new screenshots.

Now let's go get that publisher!

We'll keep you posted when we have more news ;)

notes.title: European Game Showcase
notes.content:
[h1]European Game Showcase[/h1]

[b]We have exciting news to share today!
[/b]
Replaceable was selected by the European Game Showcase to be presented during GDC. On the 19th of March we will showcase the current status and future vision of our game to the press, publishers and strategic partners.

[i]Shout out to our entire GAME.PACK
With the support of [url=https://www.vaf.be/]Vlaams Audiovisueel Fonds[/url] and [url=https://www.wallimage.be/]Wallimage[/url]
[/i]
Check out our [url=https://vimeo.com/911114832/78ae97fd88?share=copy]latest teaser here[/url].
